title: Isolating the Language Shell: A Content-Controlled Study of Multilingual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27053v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual reasoning distillation requires choosing the language in which teacher reasoning is presented, yet existing recipes often entangle linguistic form with differences in generation, translation, and filtering. We construct content-controlled supervision by rendering the same verified English trajectories into English, translated target-language, and language-mixed shells, and fine-tune two pretrained students in three target languages, evaluating them on multilingual mathematical reasoning at two difficulty levels. Even with the underlying reasoning content held fixed, we find that shell choice can change downstream accuracy, with effects varying across students, languages, and difficulty levels. Pre-training compatibility does not consistently track these outcomes, and even when our tests find no clear accuracy difference between shells, their output-language behavior can still differ substantially. translated_title: 隔离语言外壳：一项内容可控的多语言推理研究
translated_abstract: 多语言推理蒸馏需要选择呈现教师推理所使用的语言，然而现有的方法往往将语言形式与生成、翻译和过滤方面的差异混杂在一起。我们通过将相同的、经过验证的英文推理轨迹分别渲染为英文、翻译后的目标语言以及语言混合的三种外壳，构建了内容可控的监督数据，并在三种目标语言上对两个预训练的学生模型进行微调，在两个难度级别上评估它们的多语言数学推理能力。我们发现，即使在底层推理内容保持不变的情况下，外壳的选择仍会改变下游准确率，且其影响因学生模型、语言和难度级别的不同而变化。预训练兼容性并不能一致地预测这些结果，即使测试未发现不同外壳之间存在明显的准确率差异，它们的输出语言行为仍可能存在显著差异。这些结果表明……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过保持推理内容不变、仅改变教师推理呈现的语言外壳，证明多语言推理蒸馏中外壳语言的选择会显著影响学生模型的下游准确率与输出语言行为，而预训练兼容性无法预测这些效应。
en_tdlr: By holding reasoning content fixed and varying only the language shell of teacher supervision, this study shows that the choice of shell language in multilingual reasoning distillation can significantly change students' downstream accuracy and output-language behavior, effects that pre-training compatibility fails to predict.
